Its own head gate log /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261015T101418913456-srw-scheduled-retention/gate.log opens '# revision: 1847163c + lint fixes' and closes '109 passed in 36.75s' with EXIT=0 and zero FAILED or ERROR lines, and the negative-control log closes EXIT=1 with exactly one failing id (test_a_rewrite_that_keeps_the_time_and_length_is_caught_by_the_digest) that the head arm passes. added_failure_count is 0 by construction from those facts, not by a differenced measurement.

findings.text: blocking: the fleet service launches the standing loop as "imas-ambix agent ingest" (services.json), and that command calls telemetry_ingest.run with no retention argument, so ScheduledRetention is constructed only in telemetry_ingest.main at imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_ingest.py:490, which no console script or service reaches; the node's goal is therefore inert in production and the section's change deletes nothing.

follow-on: forget copies the "DELETE FROM sample ...; DELETE FROM source ..." pair that _drop_deselected_tiers already performs at imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_index.py:1302-1306 and the rewrite path performs at :1382, so a third copy of the source-row removal now exists and a later change to the sample/source keying has three places to find.

follow-on: retention() runs in run()'s else branch outside the try that catches sqlite3.OperationalError, and retention_pass catches only RuntimeError at imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_ingest.py:134, so an OSError from write_manifest/os.replace or a lock error from index.vacuum (VACUUM needs an exclusive lock a concurrent reader can hold) propagates out of the standing loop and stops the one writer of the index.

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the ingest loop retires proven-equal raw receipt files daily; the machinery is landed in imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_retention.py and imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_ingest.py:101, but the production ingest loop at imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2945 calls telemetry_ingest.run with no retention argument, so the pass never runs in the deployed service.
